nodes.title: 提示词
widgets_values:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced; at 5.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 2> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description:
Single-take constraint: exactly one continuous shot from first frame to last frame. No cuts, shot switches, jump cuts, dissolves, wipes, fade transitions, hidden cuts behind occlusion, abrupt viewpoint resets or scene morphing. All framing changes must result from a visible continuous camera path, with coherent intermediate views, parallax and lighting. Action-speed ramps do not interrupt the take.

Action speed: 0.00–0.50 seconds continues pronounced slow motion as the cup approaches the palm; 0.50–0.90 seconds smoothly accelerates to a quick real-time catch; 0.90–2.80 seconds is brisk but controlled real-time hand coordination and lanyard replacement, not slow motion; 2.80–4.20 seconds is relaxed natural real-time movement while straightening and presenting the screen; 4.20–5.00 seconds is a natural real-time smile and breathing hold, not slow motion or a freeze frame. Camera dolly stays subtle and slow throughout.

[Shot 1] Photorealistic continuous recovery shot. Start with the phone already held, the cup above the opposite open palm and the badge hanging from that wrist. During 0.00–0.90 seconds she closes her fingers around the descending cup and cushions it without spilling. During 0.90–2.80 seconds, while retaining both objects, she briefly brings the hands together at chest height, pinches the existing lanyard loop between her available fingertips, draws it off the wrist, bows her head and visibly lifts the loop over her bun onto her neck; the badge settles against her blouse. Do not add a second badge or let the strap pass through her head, cup or phone. During 2.80–4.20 seconds she straightens, turns the held phone so its screen faces the camera, and separates her hands into the last-frame pose. During 4.20–5.00 seconds hold a composed smile and stable presentation with only natural breathing. The camera makes a subtle slow forward dolly and reframes to the exact final medium close-up. Keep the phone screen layout visually consistent with the last frame without inventing readable text. Maintain identity, clothing, opaque skin and exactly one of each prop. No speech, subtitles, graphics, bones or glow.

overall_soundscape:
A soft paper-cup catch, gentle strap and fabric rustle during the lanyard reset, and steady quiet lobby ventilation. No dialogue or applause.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A
